name: TsDUiSZ
source:
The main heroine has a unique ability, and when NON-suspicious individuals from a NON-suspicious organization offer her an interesting contract right during her break from working at the office, she accepts without hesitation. And who among us would not agree to adventure and a hundred thousand hryvnias (at the exchange rate of three dollars per hryvnia) in addition?

[Translated from [url=https://a-wovk.itch.io/tsduisz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女主角拥有独特的能力，当她在办公室休息期间，来自无可疑组织的无可疑人员向她提供了一份有趣的合同时，她毫不犹豫地接受了。我们当中谁会不同意冒险和另外十万格里夫纳（按每格里夫纳三美元的汇率计算）呢？

[译自[url=https://a-wovk.itch.io/tsduisz]itch.io[/url]]
